subject: SCCs mapping + UK addendum sequencing for Beacon Health go-live
messages:
From: Emily Soto <emily.soto@beaconhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Beacon Health Legal <legal@beaconhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: evidence & sequencing for inbound EU→US data flows

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking this on. As Beacon ramps to production with Redwood we need a clear deliverable list and sequencing for the international transfer controls (SCCs / UK addendum / DTIA). Our HIT/PHI mapping flagged any flows that transit from EU to the US, and legal needs to stitch together a few things before our April 15 go-live:

- Evidence pack: where we can pull copies of technical descriptions, subprocessor list (with regions), and KV/cache handling notes.
- DTIA/SCC mapping: we need a mapping doc that ties our processing activities to the appropriate SCC clauses and any additional safeguards (encryption at-rest, pseudonymization).
- UK position: does Redwood sign the UK Addendum (IDTA) or do we rely on SCCs + contractual assurances?
- Timeline: final DPA signature by week of Mar 27 ideally.

I've attached a Beacon-side checklist to show the format we expect (Beacon_Evidence_Checklist.pdf). Can you confirm what you can provide and realistic dates? Also flag anything that will require architectural change.

Best,
Emily
Emily Soto
Senior Privacy Counsel
Beacon Health
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Soto <emily.soto@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & sequencing for inbound EU→US data flows

Hi Emily — thanks, and really appreciate the checklist.

Short answer: we can produce an initial evidence bundle and a DTIA mapping that aligns the processing activities to SCC 2/4/5-type clauses; we also accept the UK Addendum (IDTA) as a route we will execute when requested by customers in-scope for UK transfer controls.

Proposed deliverables and dates:
- Mar 17: initial evidence pack (technical overview, subprocessors export list, retention summary)
- Mar 20: DTIA mapping spreadsheet that rows your processing activities against SCC/UK addendum clauses
- Mar 22: copy of our SOC2 report and links for auditors (we'll provide a redacted PDF)
- Mar 27: final DPA with UK addendum ready for signature (DocuSign)

Questions for you:
1) Do you require on-premise or dedicated-region processing for any data class? (If yes, that will affect timelines.)
2) Any specific logging/audit retention requirements beyond our standard 12 months?

I'll loop Marissa (legal) to assemble the mapping and Vivek for compliance sign-off. If those dates look tight, tell me which ones to prioritize.

-Connor
Connor O'Brien
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Soto <emily.soto@beaconhealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & sequencing for inbound EU→US data flows

Hi Emily — following up with the artifacts we discussed. Attached: dtia-mapping-beaconhealth.xlsx and subprocessors_Q1_2028.csv.

A few clarifications up front:
- Redwood's baseline is SCCs (EU Standard Contractual Clauses) for EU→US transfers, and we will execute the UK IDTA addendum where customers require it. We treat the IDTA as a supplement to SCCs for UK-origin data.
- Our subprocessors fall into three categories on the attached CSV: Cloud infra (regional), Observability/metrics (no customer content retained), and Optional managed services (KV caching, model-hosting partners). The CSV includes the country of processing and contractual subprocessor obligations.
- Technical safeguards we will document in the mapping: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest for customer content, default pseudonymization for logs, and optional field-level pseudonymization on request.

Action items for Beacon (please confirm):
- Retention window for request logs (default 12 months; flag if you need 24/36).
- Whether Beacon requires a signed UK Addendum now or prefers to sign at contract execution.

Links: HubSpot record for this deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/BeaconHealth
Evidence share (will upload full pack by EOD Mar 17): https://redwood-drive.company/shared/BeaconHealth_DTIA_Evidence

Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference
From: Emily Soto <emily.soto@beaconhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-16T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & sequencing for inbound EU→US data flows

Thanks Marissa — the CSV is helpful. A few quick items:

- Beacon prefers the UK Addendum signed at contract execution (so please include that in the DPA draft).
- Retention: we need request/trace logs retained 24 months for auditability. Can Redwood support 24 months?
- For dedicated-region question: some PHI workflows prefer EU-only processing. Can you confirm whether Redwood Dedicated can pin processing to eu-west-1 for a scoped dataset? If so, we may require that config for a subset of customer traffic.

Attached is our security questionnaire (Beacon_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — it's short; please route to your security team.

Emily
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Soto <emily.soto@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-17T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & sequencing for inbound EU→US data flows

Emily — quick note from compliance to close the loop.

1) SOC2: see attached SOC2_report_redwood_2027.pdf (redacted). We will also provide auditor contact details via the evidence share link.
2) Retention: we can extend request/log retention to 24 months for Beacon as a configuration in the tenant policy; we'll include the retention clause in the DPA.
3) Dedicated region: Redwood Dedicated can pin processing to eu-west-1 for a scoped dataset; that requires the Dedicated configuration in the SOW and a short validation window (typically 2 weeks).
4) UK Addendum: Redwood will include and sign the UK IDTA addendum at contract execution. We will prepare the DPA with both SCCs and the UK addendum clauses included; final signature via DocuSign.

Next steps:
- Mar 17 EOD: full evidence bundle uploaded to the shared drive (Marissa/Connor) — link above.
- Mar 20: DTIA mapping delivered and we sync for any open redlines.
- Mar 27: DPA + UK Addendum ready for signature.

For DocuSign next steps, use this placeholder (DocuSign to follow): https://docusign.com/r/redwood-beacon-BH28 (will be live once redlines are agreed).

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
